text:
```yaml
name: Security Scan

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 10 * * *'
  pull_request: {}
  push:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  security-scan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Build Docker image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: .
          file: Dockerfile
          tags: opentelemetry-mcp-server:latest
          load: true

      - name: Scan image with Trivy
        uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@v0.1.0
        with:
          image-ref: opentelemetry-mcp-server:latest
          format: table
          exit-code: 1
          severity: HIGH,CRITICAL
          ignore-unfixed: true
```
